p9_b2.ocr: The rise in cyber threats, particularly ransomware and phishing attacks, poses significant challenges to businesses, prompting a reevaluation of their security postures. Recent statistics indicate that ransomware incidents have surged to 80 reported cases, representing a 10% increase from the previous year.

p9_b3.ocr: Meanwhile, phishing attempts have escalated dramatically, with a staggering 120 incidents recorded, accounting for 25% of all reported cyber incidents. In light of these threats, organizations are significantly increasing their investment in cloud infrastructure to enhance security and operational resilience.
